description: Proposes that a recorded artifact may be the recording of a call-log entry. Time agreement is the gate; duration and number agreement are reported as separate evidence. No probability is computed; ambiguity (several calls within tolerance) is kept.

left.selector: artifacts with audio/* or video/* MIME type

criteria.time: gate: |recording start - call start| <= time_tolerance_seconds for an explicit/epoch/assumed instant; for an unknown-zone wall clock some allowed UTC offset must bring the residual within tolerance; recording candidates are limited to recording_time_kinds (file_mtime excluded by default: copying changes it); every other matching tested point is listed as an alternative
criteria.duration: evidence: |recording duration - call duration| <= max(duration_tolerance_seconds, duration_tolerance_ratio * call duration)
criteria.number: evidence: normalized digits of the filename-derived number hypothesis equal the call number or share the last number_suffix_digits digits
